notes.title: Bug Fixes + New Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi all,



We've fixed a number of gameplay and visual bugs in this latest release and have also introduced 11 new achievements.



Bugs Fixed:

Fixed an issue where you could still attack despite being frozen as an ice cube.

Moved all spawn points to properly be on the ground. Previously some were floating above the ground on certain maps.

Fixed an issue where if you were the last person alive, and then died, the camera would zoom out.

Fixed a Steamdeck specific issue where certain details like shadows and ground markings were not properly being displayed on maps.



Achievements Introduced:
[olist]
🔥 Fire Breath: Eliminate 3 opponents at once with the Fire Breath powerup.

🌋 Trailblazer: Cause an opponent to step into your Fire Trail.

🧊 Ice Ice Bao: Cause an opponent to freeze on your Ice Trail.

🛡️ Rock Solid: Block 3 incoming thrown attacks at once using the Earth Shield.

❄️ Chill Out!: Freeze 2 or more opponents at once with the Ice Ring.

🌞 Blinded by the Bite: Blind 3 or more opponents at once with the Sun Ring.

🍄 Make Bao, Not War: Affect 4 or more opponents at once with the Mushroom Ring.

💤 Sleeping Dumpling: Win a round without throwing your fan or attacking.

👻 Ghost Stories: Eliminate 2 opponents after you've been eliminated.

♨️ Overcooked: Get eliminated by a fire based environmental hazard 5 times.

🚧 Occupational Hazard: Get eliminated by an environmental hazard 10 times.
[/olist]


Thanks, and see you in game!

Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team

notes.title: Demo Update 2.0: 10 New Arenas, New Powerups, & An Original Sountrack 🙌
notes.notes:
Get ready to experience Shaolin Bao like never before – we’ve packed this major update with a whole host of new features, wild arenas, and fresh music to keep the action sizzling!

🔥 10 Brand New Arenas!

Step into a dozen new battlegrounds (okay, 10 arenas, but they’re awesome!) where every map challenges you with its own twist. Here’s just a sneak peek of what’s waiting for you, but to truly feel the chaos, grab some friends and jump into the demo:

 Giant, Smashing Stone Hands poised to crush the unprepared – can you slip through in time?
 Spike Trap Mazes reworking the flow of movement, forcing you to rethink your path to survive!
Ready to prove your skills? Play the demo and discover even more surprises on the battlefield!

⚡ Powerup Extravaganza!

Amp up your gameplay with a slew of new powerups, exciting tweaks to fan favorites, and yes—we’ve removed a few that didn’t quite make the cut. Here's a little teaser of what's in store:

 Earth Shield: Encase yourself in a ring of rock-solid shields, perfect for shrugging off enemy attacks.
 Ice Ring: Unleash a burst of icy energy, freezing foes in their tracks and shifting the tide of battle.
 Mushroom Ring: Turn your foes into  adorable, peaceful mushrooms, making them lose their ability to attack… but just for a bit.
Curious about the rest? Jump into the demo with your friends to discover all the new powerups waiting to spice up your battles!

🎶 Expanded Original Soundtrack

Jam out to our enhanced Shaolin Bao soundtrack featuring all-new arrangements and beats that perfectly complement the high-energy chaos on screen.

Huge shout-out to the incredibly talented Howard Chi and Joshua Yang, for these incredible tracks!

The beats are so good, you might just find yourself lingering in-game, not to battle, but to vibe. They're that catchy!

🐞 Bug Fixes & Quality Improvements

We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs and polishing up the game. Your experience should be a lot smoother with this update!

💬 Wishlist us on Steam!
We’re excited for you to dive into these new features and see how they spice up the battlefield. As always, your feedback is the secret ingredient that makes Shaolin Bao even better, we're excited to hear from you!

🍜 Happy gaming!
Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348740/Shaolin_Bao_Demo/

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1: Bots 🎮 and Beats 🎶
notes.notes:
We’ve got some exciting updates for the Shaolin Bao demo that are sure to make your battles even more deliciously fun! Here's what’s cooking in this update:

🥢 Play Against AI Bots!
No friends nearby? No problem! You can now face off against AI bots. Perfect for sharpening your bao-throwing skills!

🎵 New Original Music!
Immerse yourself in the world of Shaolin Bao with our amazing new original music! A taste of which is in our demo. Get ready for some toe-tapping, fan-slinging action!

⚙️ Performance & Bug Fixes
We’ve made minor tweaks and squashed some pesky bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.

Give the new features a try, and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps make Shaolin Bao even better.

💬 Wishlist us on Steam!
Enjoy the update, and keep those fans flying! 🪭✨

🥢 Keep it tasty,
Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team
